summary: Phase 1+2 foundation tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass — health, JWT auth (login/me/invalid/no-token), institutions CRUD with tenant scoping, academic structure (programmes/courses/campuses, ISB=6/8/2, EAIC=8), cross-tenant 403, 4 ISB users, 15 roles, dashboard counts/metrics. Frontend: login (via demo chip) → /, html class swaps to isb-theme/eaic-theme/bradford-theme on switcher select, dashboard metrics update (920/1450/12400), 15 sidebar nav items load without crash, language switcher toggles dir=rtl on AR and back to ltr on EN, Institution Setup 4-step wizard navigates and PATCH /institutions persists, Academic Structure adds programme (toast + Programmes count goes 6→8; tree just renders collapsed by default), Users & Roles tabs + search filter, Settings renders, Logout clears token and redirects to /login.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on initial mount before layout settles. Charts render correctly once container has dimensions, but suggest wrapping ResponsiveContainer with explicit minHeight or aspect to silence the warnings.

Tree defaults to fully collapsed; after adding a new programme the success toast fires and the right-rail PROGRAMMES counter increments correctly, but the new node is hidden until the user manually expands the campus → department branch. Consider auto-expanding the relevant branch (or the whole tree on first load) so newly added programmes are immediately visible.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width/height warnings by setting minHeight or aspect on ResponsiveContainer wrappers in Dashboard charts.

Optional UX: auto-expand newly added programme branch in AcademicStructure tree (or expand the whole tree by default) so the create-flow has visible feedback in the tree itself, not just the right-rail counter.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (~540 lines) — still under the 700-line guideline but as Phase 3 adds AI/content/assessment modules, plan to split into routers/auth/academic/dashboard modules.

Seeded admin password reset only on mismatch — good idempotency. Demo user passwords are unconditionally re-hashed on every startup (line 491) which is fine for demo but wastes a few hundred ms each boot; consider gating on verify_password mismatch too.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo; tighten to explicit origins for prod.
No rate-limit / lockout on /api/auth/login (auth_testing.md mentions 5-fail lockout). For demo it's fine but should be added before exposing publicly.

create_token embeds role/institution_id in JWT but get_current_user re-reads user from DB on every request — good for revocation but a small cache layer (or trust the JWT claims for non-mutating reads) would reduce DB load at scale.
_scoped_query raises 403 inside a function that returns a query — slightly surprising control flow; consider splitting into authorize_tenant() (raises) + tenant_filter() (returns dict).

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 institutions, 15 roles, 11 users, full academic tree on startup. Tests created/cleaned TEST_ prefixed programme to validate POST+GET persistence and DELETE cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1+2 endpoints + UI flows verified green. backend_test.py covers 18 cases (health, auth happy/sad paths, tenant-scoped lists, cross-tenant 403, create+verify programme, dashboard). Frontend verified via Playwright: login (demo chip → 'Continue' button), institution switcher (data-testid='institution-option-isb/eaic/uob' swaps html class and dashboard metrics 920/1450/12400), language-en/ar toggle dir on <html>, 15 sidebar nav links navigate without crash, wizard 4 steps + Save (PATCH), academic-structure add programme (toast + counter increments — tree starts collapsed by design), users-roles tabs + search, settings, logout clears 'academiaos_token'. Only nits are Recharts width(-1) warnings on first mount and the collapsed-tree UX. No blocking issues found.
